body.name: Fixed-time Wald interval
body.construction: For \(0<\alpha<1\), \(\mathcal I_{n,B}(\alpha)=[\widehat\tau_{d^{\mathrm{pre}}_{n,B}}-z_{1-\alpha/2}\widehat{\mathrm{se}}_{n,B},\widehat\tau_{d^{\mathrm{pre}}_{n,B}}+z_{1-\alpha/2}\widehat{\mathrm{se}}_{n,B}]\), where \(z_\gamma\) is the \(\gamma\)-quantile of \(\mathcal N(0,1)\).
